findings.title: Old-owner conversion release gate passes with portable generation-9 fixture
findings.observed: The merged #1021 portable fixture enabled an isolated exact rerun. The ignored gate passed in 636 seconds with one Cargo test covering seven roles, 12 scenarios, and 30 fault cases.
findings.impact: The complete conversion and finite recovery denominator is proven for the corrected harness and portable fixture.
findings.scope_boundary: The passing retained #872 validator and current-candidate conversion suites remain valid corroboration, but neither substitutes for this gate.
findings.recommended_disposition: Resolved by merged #1021 and independently rerun for #873.
findings.resolution: Passed against source commit 717056d405dc01d75402d33b2bf0d0e7ec3e4768; no live conversion, shared installation, or writer activation occurred.

findings.title: Prepared-start context is warm-host and explicitly retained
findings.observed: The exact frozen candidate passed the retained warm-host samples, including a 6.588-second candidate-first sample; each artifact states that no cache reset or OS-cold measurement occurred.
findings.impact: No qualification blocker under the source contract: it requires a prepared start at or below three minutes with the cold or warm context retained, and the warm context is explicit.
findings.recommended_disposition: No remediation required. Preserve the warm-host condition and continue to make no OS-cold claim.
findings.disposition: Closed as non-blocking. The 6.588-second warm-host candidate-first sample passes the three-minute target, the context is retained, and no OS-cold claim is made.

findings.title: Avoidable retry reduction lacks a comparable baseline denominator
findings.observed: The exact predecessor completed both shared journeys with 34 attempts and three avoidable retries. The frozen candidate refused the authority-valid source baseline at prepare with semantic_prepare_refused / LegacyMigrationRequired. Among 89 retained fixture roots, no authority-valid clean baseline without the tracked issue-505 terminal receipt exists; the two clean normalized roots retain operational_context_required because authority became stale.
findings.impact: No comparable candidate ledger exists, so no retry-reduction percentage or 50 percent claim can be calculated.
findings.recommended_disposition: Provide an authenticated authority-valid fixture whose baseline does not trigger legacy migration, while preserving the frozen binary and shared scenario, then rerun the candidate and comparator.
findings.scope_boundary: Candidate-only archive interruption/recovery remains separately qualified and excluded from the common retry denominator. Exploratory failed runs do not supply a comparison payload.

findings.title: Issue #873 evidence PR CI is not observed
findings.observed: The frozen source candidate CI is green, but this evidence-only branch has not been published and therefore has no PR CI result.
findings.impact: The issue-specific aggregate CI gate remains not proven.
findings.recommended_disposition: Observe required checks after authorized publication.

findings.title: Independent exact-head review of the remediated evidence is not observed
findings.observed: The prior review produced remediation findings; no independent review result exists for the remediation commit yet.
findings.impact: The exact-head review gate remains not proven.
findings.recommended_disposition: Run an independent evidence review at the remediation commit and retain its disposition.

findings.title: Prepared-start artifact originally measured non-frozen candidate bytes
findings.observed: The replaced artifact used candidate BLAKE3 7bf9bd57 instead of frozen installed BLAKE3 c6d7c79a.
findings.resolution: The harness now verifies SHA-256, places the exact frozen binary in the isolated candidate slot, rejects mismatched sample digests, and retained three candidate samples with BLAKE3 c6d7c79a.

findings.title: Replay scripts embedded machine and operator paths
findings.resolution: Replay paths are derived from the repository or supplied through named environment inputs; authored summaries use logical references.

findings.title: Scorecard used statuses outside pass, fail, and not_proven
findings.resolution: All scorecard gates now use only pass, fail, or not_proven; conversion recovery passes, while evidence PR CI and exact-head review remain not_proven.

findings.title: Prepared-start replay built outside a selected non-default target directory
findings.observed: The replay script searched ADL_ISSUE873_TIMING_TARGET_DIR but its Cargo no-run build previously used Cargo's default target directory.
findings.resolution: The build now receives CARGO_TARGET_DIR equal to the selected target. A build-only probe passed with a non-default target and discovered both required executables beneath it.
